title: Chapter 1 – Arjuna Viṣāda Yoga (The Yoga of Arjuna’s Despondency)
subtitle: Yoga of Arjuna's Grief

verses.title: 1.1 dharma-kshetre
verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच ।
धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः ।
मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय ॥ १-१॥
verses.roman:
dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca
dharmakṣetre kurukṣetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ
māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāścaiva kimakurvata sañjaya 1-1
verses.colloquial:
dhritaraashtra uvaacha
dharma kshetre kuru kshetre samavetaa yuyutsavah
maamakaah paandavaah cha eva kim akurvata sanjaya 1-1
verses.translation_reworded: Dhritarashtra said: Sanjaya, tell me what my sons and the sons of Pandu did once they had gathered, eager for battle, on the sacred field of Kurukshetra.

verses.title: 1.2 drishtva tu pandavanikam
verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच । 
दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा ।
आचार्यमुपसङ्गम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत् ॥ १-२॥
verses.roman:
sañjaya uvāca
dṛṣṭvā tu pāṇḍavānīkaṃ vyūḍhaṃ duryodhanastadā
ācāryamupasaṅgamya rājā vacanamabravīt 1-2
verses.colloquial:
sanjaya uvaacha
drishtvaa tu paandava aniikam vyuudham duryodhanah tadaa
aachaaryam upasangamya raajaa vachanam abraviit 1-2
verses.translation_reworded: Sanjaya said: When King Duryodhana saw the Pandava army arranged in battle formation, he went up to his teacher Drona and spoke these words.

verses.title: 1.3 pashyaitam pandu-putranam
verses.sanskrit:
पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य महतीं चमूम् ।
व्यूढां द्रुपदपुत्रेण तव शिष्येण धीमता ॥ १-३॥
verses.roman:
paśyaitāṃ pāṇḍuputrāṇāmācārya mahatīṃ camūm
vyūḍhāṃ drupadaputreṇa tava śiṣyeṇa dhīmatā 1-3
verses.colloquial:
pashya etaam paandu putraanaam aachaarya mahatiim chamuum
vyuudhaam drupada putrena tava shishyena dhiimataa 1-3
verses.translation_reworded: Teacher, look at this great army of the sons of Pandu, drawn up for battle by your gifted pupil, the son of Drupada.

verses.title: 1.4 atra shura maheshvasa
verses.sanskrit:
अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि ।
युयुधानो विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः ॥ १-४॥
verses.roman:
atra śūrā maheṣvāsā bhīmārjunasamā yudhi
yuyudhāno virāṭaśca drupadaśca mahārathaḥ 1-4
verses.colloquial:
atra shuuraa maheshvaasaa bhiimaarjuna samaa yudhi
yuyudhaano viraatashcha drupadashcha mahaa rathah 1-4
verses.translation_reworded: In it stand heroes and powerful archers who match Bhima and Arjuna in combat: Yuyudhana, Virata and Drupada, each of whom leads eleven thousand archers.

verses.title: 1.5 dhrishtaketushchekitanah
verses.sanskrit:
धृष्टकेतुश्चेकितानः काशिराजश्च वीर्यवान् ।
पुरुजित्कुन्तिभोजश्च शैब्यश्च नरपुङ्गवः ॥ १-५॥
verses.roman:
dhṛṣṭaketuścekitānaḥ kāśirājaśca vīryavān
purujitkuntibhojaśca śaibyaśca narapuṅgavaḥ 1-5
verses.colloquial:
dhrishtaketush chekitaanah kaashiraajash cha viiryavaan
purujit kuntibhojash cha shaibyash cha nara pungavah 1-5
verses.translation_reworded: There are Dhrishtaketu, Chekitana and the courageous king of Kashi, along with Purujit, Kuntibhoja and Saibya, the finest of men.

verses.title: 1.6 yudhamanyushcha vikranta
verses.sanskrit:
युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्त उत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान् ।
सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्व एव महारथाः ॥ १-६॥
verses.roman:
yudhāmanyuśca vikrānta uttamaujāśca vīryavān
saubhadro draupadeyāśca sarva eva mahārathāḥ 1-6
verses.colloquial:
yudhaamanyushcha vikraanta uttamaujaashcha viiryavaan
saubhadro draupadeyaashcha sarva eva mahaa rathaah 1-6
verses.translation_reworded: There are the powerful Yudhamanyu and the brave Uttamaujas, the son of Subhadra and the sons of Draupadi, every one of them a commander of a division.

verses.title: 1.7 asmakam tu vishishta
verses.sanskrit:
अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम ।
नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते ॥ १-७॥
verses.roman:
asmākaṃ tu viśiṣṭā ye tānnibodha dvijottama
nāyakā mama sainyasya saṃjñārthaṃ tānbravīmi te 1-7
verses.colloquial:
asmaakam tu vishishtaa ye taan nibodha dvijottama
naayakaa mama sainyasya samjnaartham taan braviimi te 1-7
verses.translation_reworded: Now, best of the twice-born, learn too the names of the most outstanding men on our own side, the leaders of my army. I list them so that you know who they are.

verses.title: 1.8 bhavanbhishmashcha
verses.sanskrit:
भवान्भीष्मश्च कर्णश्च कृपश्च समितिञ्जयः ।
अश्वत्थामा विकर्णश्च सौमदत्तिस्तथैव च ॥ १-८॥
verses.roman:
bhavānbhīṣmaśca karṇaśca kṛpaśca samitiñjayaḥ
aśvatthāmā vikarṇaśca saumadattistathaiva ca 1-8
verses.colloquial:
bhavaan bhiishmash cha karnash cha kripash cha samitinjayah
ashvatthaamaa vikarnash cha saumadattih tathaiva cha 1-8
verses.translation_reworded: You yourself, and Bhishma, and Karna, and Kripa who is always victorious in war; Aswatthama, Vikarna, and the son of Somadatta as well.

verses.title: 1.9 anye cha bahavah shura
verses.sanskrit:
अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः ।
नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः ॥ १-९॥
verses.roman:
anye ca bahavaḥ śūrā madarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ
nānāśastrapraharaṇāḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ 1-9
verses.colloquial:
anye cha bahavah shuuraa madarthe tyakta jiivitaah
naanaa shastra praharanaah sarve yuddha vishaaradaah 1-9
verses.translation_reworded: And there are many other heroes, ready to lay down their lives for my sake, carrying every kind of weapon and missile, all of them expert in warfare.

verses.title: 1.10 aparyaptam tadasmakam
verses.sanskrit:
अपर्याप्तं तदस्माकं बलं भीष्माभिरक्षितम् ।
पर्याप्तं त्विदमेतेषां बलं भीमाभिरक्षितम् ॥ १-१०॥
verses.roman:
aparyāptaṃ tadasmākaṃ balaṃ bhīṣmābhirakṣitam
paryāptaṃ tvidameteṣāṃ balaṃ bhīmābhirakṣitam 1-10
verses.colloquial:
aparyaaptam tad asmaakam balam bhiishma abhi rakshitam
paryaaptam tu idam eteshaam balam bhiima abhi rakshitam 1-10
verses.translation_reworded: This army of ours, guarded by Bhishma, is not enough, while that army of theirs, guarded by Bhima, is enough. Alternatively: this army of ours, protected by Bhishma, is without limit, while that army of theirs, protected by Bhima, is limited.

verses.title: 1.11 ayaneshu cha sarveshu
verses.sanskrit:
अयनेषु च सर्वेषु यथाभागमवस्थिताः ।
भीष्ममेवाभिरक्षन्तु भवन्तः सर्व एव हि ॥ १-११॥
verses.roman:
ayaneṣu ca sarveṣu yathābhāgamavasthitāḥ
bhīṣmamevābhirakṣantu bhavantaḥ sarva eva hi 1-11
verses.colloquial:
ayaneshu cha sarveshu yathaabhaagam avasthitaah
bhiishmam eva abhirakshantu bhavantah sarva eva hi 1-11
verses.translation_reworded: So all of you, each holding his assigned post in the various divisions of the army, must guard Bhishma above everyone else.

verses.title: 1.12 tasya sanjanayan
verses.sanskrit:
तस्य सञ्जनयन्हर्षं कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः ।
सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्खं दध्मौ प्रतापवान् ॥ १-१२॥
verses.roman:
tasya sañjanayanharṣaṃ kuruvṛddhaḥ pitāmahaḥ
siṃhanādaṃ vinadyoccaiḥ śaṅkhaṃ dadhmau pratāpavān 1-12
verses.colloquial:
tasya sanjanayan harsham kuruvriddhah pitaamahah
simhanaadam vinadya ucchaih shankham dadhmau prataapavaan 1-12
verses.translation_reworded: To lift Duryodhana's spirits, his illustrious grandsire Bhishma, the eldest of the Kauravas, then let out a roar like a lion's and blew his conch.

verses.title: 1.13 tatah shankhashcha
verses.sanskrit:
ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च पणवानकगोमुखाः ।
सहसैवाभ्यहन्यन्त स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत् ॥ १-१३॥
verses.roman:
tataḥ śaṅkhāśca bheryaśca paṇavānakagomukhāḥ
sahasaivābhyahanyanta sa śabdastumulo'bhavat 1-13
verses.colloquial:
tatah shankhaash cha bheryash cha panava aanaka gomukhaah
sahasaa eva abhyahanyanta sa shabdah tumulah abhavat 1-13
verses.translation_reworded: Right after Bhishma, conches and kettledrums, tabors, drums and cow-horns all burst into sound at once, and the noise was overwhelming.

verses.title: 1.14 tatah shvetairhayairyukte
verses.sanskrit:
ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ ।
माधवः पाण्डवश्चैव दिव्यौ शङ्खौ प्रदध्मतुः ॥ १-१४॥
verses.roman:
tataḥ śvetairhayairyukte mahati syandane sthitau
mādhavaḥ pāṇḍavaścaiva divyau śaṅkhau pradadhmatuḥ 1-14
verses.colloquial:
tatah shvetair hayair yukte mahati syandane sthitau
maadhavah paandavash chaiva divyau shankhau pradadhmatuh 1-14
verses.translation_reworded: Then Madhava and the son of Pandu, seated in their splendid chariot drawn by white horses, blew their divine conches too.

verses.title: 1.15 panchajanyam hrishikesho
verses.sanskrit:
पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनञ्जयः ।
पौण्ड्रं दध्मौ महाशङ्खं भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः ॥ १-१५॥
verses.roman:
pāñcajanyaṃ hṛṣīkeśo devadattaṃ dhanañjayaḥ
pauṇḍraṃ dadhmau mahāśaṅkhaṃ bhīmakarmā vṛkodaraḥ 1-15
verses.colloquial:
paanchajanyam hrishiikesho devadattam dhananjayah
paundram dadhmau mahaa shankham bhiima karmaa vrikodarah 1-15
verses.translation_reworded: Hrishikesha blew the Panchajanya, Dhananjaya (Arjuna) blew the Devadatta, and Vrikodara (Bhima), who performs fearsome deeds, blew his great conch called Paundra.

verses.title: 1.16 anantavijayam raja
verses.sanskrit:
अनन्तविजयं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ।
नकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ ॥ १-१६॥
verses.roman:
anantavijayaṃ rājā kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
nakulaḥ sahadevaśca sughoṣamaṇipuṣpakau 1-16
verses.colloquial:
ananta vijayam raajaa kuntii putro yudhishthirah
nakulah sahadevashcha sughosha manipushpakau 1-16
verses.translation_reworded: King Yudhisthira, Kunti's son, blew the Anantavijaya; Nakula and Sahadeva blew the Sughosha and the Manipushpaka.

verses.title: 1.17 kashyashcha parameshvasah
verses.sanskrit:
काश्यश्च परमेष्वासः शिखण्डी च महारथः ।
धृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्चापराजितः ॥ १-१७॥
verses.roman:
kāśyaśca parameṣvāsaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca mahārathaḥ
dhṛṣṭadyumno virāṭaśca sātyakiścāparājitaḥ 1-17
verses.colloquial:
kaashyash cha parama ishvaasah shikhandii cha mahaa rathah
dhrishtadyumnah viraatash cha saatyakih cha aparaajitah 1-17
verses.translation_reworded: The king of Kashi, a superb archer; Shikhandi, the mighty commander of eleven thousand archers; Dhristadyumna, Virata, and the undefeated Satyaki;

verses.title: 1.18 drupado draupadeyashcha
verses.sanskrit:
द्रुपदो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः पृथिवीपते ।
सौभद्रश्च महाबाहुः शङ्खान्दध्मुः पृथक्पृथक् ॥ १-१८॥
verses.roman:
drupado draupadeyāśca sarvaśaḥ pṛthivīpate
saubhadraśca mahābāhuḥ śaṅkhāndadhmuḥ pṛthakpṛthak 1-18
verses.colloquial:
drupado draupadeyaash cha sarvashah prithiviipate
saubhadrash cha mahaa baahuh shankhaan dadhmuh prithak prithak 1-18
verses.translation_reworded: Drupada, the sons of Draupadi, and the strong-armed son of Subhadra, O Lord of the Earth, each blew his own conch.

verses.title: 1.19 sa ghosho dhartarashtranam
verses.sanskrit:
स घोषो धार्तराष्ट्राणां हृदयानि व्यदारयत् ।
नभश्च पृथिवीं चैव तुमुलोऽभ्यनुनादयन् ॥ १-१९॥
verses.roman:
sa ghoṣo dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ hṛdayāni vyadārayat
nabhaśca pṛthivīṃ caiva tumulo'bhyanunādayan 1-19
verses.colloquial:
sa ghosho dhaarta raashtraanaam hridayaani vyadaarayat
nabhashcha prithiviim chaiva tumulah abhyanunaadayan 1-19
verses.translation_reworded: That thunderous sound tore at the hearts of Dhritarashtra's people and made both sky and earth echo with it.

verses.title: 1.20 atha vyavasthitan
verses.sanskrit:
अथ व्यवस्थितान्दृष्ट्वा धार्तराष्ट्रान् कपिध्वजः ।
प्रवृत्ते शस्त्रसम्पाते धनुरुद्यम्य पाण्डवः ।
हृषीकेशं तदा वाक्यमिदमाह महीपते ॥ १-२०॥
verses.roman:
atha vyavasthitāndṛṣṭvā dhārtarāṣṭrān kapidhvajaḥ
pravṛtte śastrasampāte dhanurudyamya pāṇḍavaḥ
hṛṣīkeśaṃ tadā vākyamidamāha mahīpate1-20
verses.colloquial:
atha vyavasthitaan drishtvaa dhaartaraashtraan kapidhvajah
pravritte shastra sampaate dhanuh udyamya paandavah
hrishiikesham tadaa vaakyam idam aaha mahiipate 20
verses.translation_reworded: Then, O Lord of the Earth, seeing Dhritarashtra's forces drawn up and the weapons about to fly, Arjuna, the son of Pandu, whose banner bore a monkey, lifted his bow and said these words to Krishna (Hrishikesha).

verses.title: 1.21 senayor ubhayor madhye
verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये रथं स्थापय मेऽच्युत ॥ १-२१॥
verses.roman:
arjuna uvāca
senayorubhayormadhye rathaṃ sthāpaya me'cyuta 1-21
verses.colloquial:
arjuna uvaacha
senayoh ubhayoh madhye ratham sthaapaya me achyuta 1-21
verses.translation_reworded: Arjuna said: Achyuta, drive my chariot between the two armies so that I can look at the men standing here ready to fight, and learn, on the eve of this battle, whom I must fight against.

verses.title: 1.22 yavadetan nirikshe
verses.sanskrit:
यावदेतान्निरीक्षेऽहं योद्धुकामानवस्थितान् ।
कैर्मया सह योद्धव्यमस्मिन् रणसमुद्यमे ॥ १-२२॥
verses.roman:
yāvadetānnirīkṣe'haṃ yoddhukāmānavasthitān
kairmayā saha yoddhavyamasmin raṇasamudyame 1-22
verses.colloquial:
yaavat etaan niriikshe'ham yoddhu kaamaan avasthitaan
kair mayaa saha yoddhavyam asmin rana samudyame 1-22
verses.translation_reworded: Achyuta, drive my chariot between the two armies so that I can look at the men standing here ready to fight, and learn, on the eve of this battle, whom I must fight against.

verses.title: 1.23 yotsyamanan avekshe
verses.sanskrit:
योत्स्यमानानवेक्षेऽहं य एतेऽत्र समागताः ।
धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्बुद्धेर्युद्धे प्रियचिकीर्षवः ॥ १-२३॥
verses.roman:
yotsyamānānavekṣe'haṃ ya ete'tra samāgatāḥ
dhārtarāṣṭrasya durbuddheryuddhe priyacikīrṣavaḥ 1-23
verses.colloquial:
yotsyamaanaan avekshe'ham ya ete'tra samaagataah
dhaartaraashtrasya durbuddher yuddhe priya chikiirshavah 1-23
verses.translation_reworded: I want to see those who have gathered here for the fight, hoping to please the wicked sons of Dhritarashtra in battle.

verses.title: 1.24 evam ukto hrishikesho
verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
एवमुक्तो हृषीकेशो गुडाकेशेन भारत ।
सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये स्थापयित्वा रथोत्तमम् ॥ १-२४॥
verses.roman:
sañjaya uvāca
evamukto hṛṣīkeśo guḍākeśena bhārata
senayorubhayormadhye sthāpayitvā rathottamam 1-24
verses.colloquial:
sanjaya uvaacha
evam ukto hrishiikesho gudaakeshena bhaarata
senayor ubhayor madhye sthaapayitvaa rathottamam 1-24
verses.translation_reworded: Sanjaya said: Spoken to in this way by Gudakesha, O Bharata, Hrishikesha drove that finest of chariots to a place between the two armies;

verses.title: 1.25 bhishma-drona-pramukhatah
verses.sanskrit:
भीष्मद्रोणप्रमुखतः सर्वेषां च महीक्षिताम् ।
उवाच पार्थ पश्यैतान् समवेतान्कुरूनिति॥ १-२५॥
verses.roman:
bhīṣmadroṇapramukhataḥ sarveṣāṃ ca mahīkṣitām
uvāca pārtha paśyaitān samavetānkurūniti 1-25
verses.colloquial:
bhiishma drona pramukhatah sarveshaam cha mahii kshitaam
uvaacha paartha pashya etaan samavetaan kuruun iti 1-25
verses.translation_reworded: and there, before Bhishma and Drona and all the kings of the earth, he said: Partha, look at these Kurus assembled here.

verses.title: 1.26 tatrapashyat sthitan
verses.sanskrit:
तत्रापश्यत्स्थितान्पार्थः पितॄनथ पितामहान् ।
आचार्यान्मातुलान्भ्रातॄन् पुत्रान्पौत्रान्सखींस्तथा ॥ १-२६॥
verses.roman:
tatrāpaśyatsthitānpārthaḥ pitṝnatha pitāmahān
ācāryānmātulānbhrātṝn putrānpautrānsakhīṃstathā 1-26
verses.colloquial:
tatra apashyat sthitaan paarthah pitriin atha pitaamahaan
aachaaryaan maatulaan bhraatriin putraan pautraan sakhiin tathaa 1-26
verses.translation_reworded: Then Partha saw, standing in both armies, fathers, grandfathers, teachers, maternal uncles, brothers, sons, grandsons, and friends as well.

verses.title: 1.27 tan samikshya sa
verses.sanskrit:
श्वशुरान्सुहृदश्चैव सेनयोरुभयोरपि ।
तान्समीक्ष्य स कौन्तेयः सर्वान्बन्धूनवस्थितान् ।
कृपया परयाविष्टो विषीदन्निदमब्रवीत्  ॥ १-२७॥
verses.roman:
śvaśurānsuhṛdaścaiva senayorubhayorapi
tānsamīkṣya sa kaunteyaḥ sarvānbandhūnavasthitān
kṛpayā parayāviṣṭo viṣīdannidamabravīt 1-27
verses.colloquial:
shvashuraan suhridash chaiva senayor ubhayor api
taan samiikshya sa kaunteyah sarvaan bandhuun avasthitaan
kripayaa parayaavishto vishiidan nidam abraviit 1-27
verses.translation_reworded: He saw fathers-in-law and companions too in both armies. Seeing all these relatives lined up for battle, the son of Kunti, overcome with deep compassion, spoke these sorrowful words.

verses.title: 1.28 drishtvemam sva-janam
verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
दृष्ट्वेमं स्वजनं कृष्ण युयुत्सुं समुपस्थितम् ॥ १-२८॥
verses.roman:
arjuna uvāca
dṛṣṭvemaṃ svajanaṃ kṛṣṇa yuyutsuṃ samupasthitam 1-28
verses.colloquial:
arjuna uvaacha
drishtva imam svajanam krishna yuyutsum samupasthitam 1-28
verses.translation_reworded: Arjuna said: Krishna, when I see my own kinsmen standing here, eager for battle,

verses.title: 1.29 vepathush cha sharire
verses.sanskrit:
सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति ।
वेपथुश्च शरीरे मे रोमहर्षश्च जायते ॥ १-२९॥
verses.roman:
sīdanti mama gātrāṇi mukhaṃ ca pariśuṣyati
vepathuśca śarīre me romaharṣaśca jāyate 1-29
verses.colloquial:
siidanti mama gaatraani mukham cha parishushyati
vepathuh cha shariire me roma harshah cha jaayate 1-29
verses.translation_reworded: my limbs give way and my mouth goes dry; my body trembles and my hair stands on end.

verses.title: 1.30 na cha shaknomy
verses.sanskrit:
गाण्डीवं स्रंसते हस्तात्त्वक्चैव परिदह्यते ।
न च शक्नोम्यवस्थातुं भ्रमतीव च मे मनः ॥ १-३०॥
verses.roman:
gāṇḍīvaṃ sraṃsate hastāttvakcaiva paridahyate
na ca śaknomyavasthātuṃ bhramatīva ca me manaḥ 1-30
verses.colloquial:
gaandiivam sramsate hastaat tvak chaiva paridahyate
na cha shaknomi avasthaatum bhramati iva cha me manah 1-30
verses.translation_reworded: The Gandiva bow slips from my grip and my skin burns all over. I cannot even stand, and my mind seems to be spinning.

verses.title: 1.31 na cha shreyo nupashyami
verses.sanskrit:
निमित्तानि च पश्यामि विपरीतानि केशव ।
न च श्रेयोऽनुपश्यामि हत्वा स्वजनमाहवे ॥ १-३१॥
verses.roman:
nimittāni ca paśyāmi viparītāni keśava
na ca śreyo'nupaśyāmi hatvā svajanamāhave 1-31
verses.colloquial:
nimittaani cha pashyaami vipariitaani keshava
na cha shreyo' anupashyaami hatvaa svajana maahave 1-31
verses.translation_reworded: I see bad omens too, Keshava, and I can see nothing good coming from killing my own relatives in battle.

verses.title: 1.32 na kankshe vijayam
verses.sanskrit:
न काङ्क्षे विजयं कृष्ण न च राज्यं सुखानि च ।
किं नो राज्येन गोविन्द किं भोगैर्जीवितेन वा ॥ १-३२॥
verses.roman:
na kāṅkṣe vijayaṃ kṛṣṇa na ca rājyaṃ sukhāni ca
kiṃ no rājyena govinda kiṃ bhogairjīvitena vā 1-32
verses.colloquial:
na kaankshe vijayam krishna na cha raajyam sukhaani cha
kim no raajyena govinda kim bhogair jiivitena vaa 1-32
verses.translation_reworded: Krishna, I have no wish for victory, or for a kingdom, or for pleasures. What use is a kingdom to us, Govinda? What use are pleasures, or even life itself?

verses.title: 1.33 yesham arthe kankshitam
verses.sanskrit:
येषामर्थे काङ्क्षितं नो राज्यं भोगाः सुखानि च ।
त इमेऽवस्थिता युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा धनानि च ॥ १-३३॥
verses.roman:
yeṣāmarthe kāṅkṣitaṃ no rājyaṃ bhogāḥ sukhāni ca
ta ime'vasthitā yuddhe prāṇāṃstyaktvā dhanāni ca 1-33
verses.colloquial:
yeshaam arthe kaankshitam no raajyam bhogaah sukhaani cha
ta ime'vasthitaa yuddhe praanaan tyaktvaa dhanaani cha 1-33
verses.translation_reworded: The very people for whose sake we want a kingdom, enjoyments and pleasures are standing here in battle, having given up their lives and their wealth.

verses.title: 1.34 acharyah pitarah putras
verses.sanskrit:
आचार्याः पितरः पुत्रास्तथैव च पितामहाः ।
मातुलाः श्वशुराः पौत्राः श्यालाः सम्बन्धिनस्तथा ॥ १-३४॥
verses.roman:
ācāryāḥ pitaraḥ putrāstathaiva ca pitāmahāḥ
mātulāḥ śvaśurāḥ pautrāḥ śyālāḥ sambandhinastathā 1-34
verses.colloquial:
aachaaryaah pitarah putraas tathaiva cha pitaamahaah
maatulaah shvashuraah pautraah shyaalaah sambandhinah tathaa 1-34
verses.translation_reworded: Teachers, fathers, sons and grandfathers; maternal uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law and other relatives.

verses.title: 1.35 etan na hantum ichchhami
verses.sanskrit:
एतान्न हन्तुमिच्छामि घ्नतोऽपि मधुसूदन ।
अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते ॥ १-३५॥
verses.roman:
etānna hantumicchāmi ghnato'pi madhusūdana
api trailokyarājyasya hetoḥ kiṃ nu mahīkṛte 1-35
verses.colloquial:
etaanna hantu micchaami ghnato'pi madhusuudana
api trailokya raajyasya hetoh kim nu mahii krite 1-35
verses.translation_reworded: Madhusudana, I do not want to kill them even if they kill me, not even to rule all three worlds, let alone for this earth.

verses.title: 1.36 nihatya dhartarashtran
verses.sanskrit:
निहत्य धार्तराष्ट्रान्नः का प्रीतिः स्याज्जनार्दन ।
पापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान् हत्वैतानाततायिनः ॥ १-३६॥
verses.roman:
nihatya dhārtarāṣṭrānnaḥ kā prītiḥ syājjanārdana
pāpamevāśrayedasmān hatvaitānātatāyinaḥ 1-36
verses.colloquial:
nihatya dhaarta raashtraan nah kaa priitih syaat janaardana
paapam eva aashrayet asmaan hatvaa etaan aatataayinah 1-36
verses.translation_reworded: What joy could we find, Janardana, in killing the sons of Dhritarashtra? Killing these criminals would bring us nothing but sin.

verses.title: 1.37 tasman narha vayam
verses.sanskrit:
तस्मान्नार्हा वयं हन्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रान्स्वबान्धवान् ।
स्वजनं हि कथं हत्वा सुखिनः स्याम माधव ॥ १-३७॥
verses.roman:
tasmānnārhā vayaṃ hantuṃ dhārtarāṣṭrānsvabāndhavān
svajanaṃ hi kathaṃ hatvā sukhinaḥ syāma mādhava 1-37
verses.colloquial:
tasmaan naarhaa vayam hantum dhaartaraashtraan svabaandhavaan
svajanam hi katham hatvaa sukhinah syaama maadhava 1-37
verses.translation_reworded: So we should not kill the sons of Dhritarashtra, who are our own relatives. How could we ever be happy, Madhava, after killing our own people?

verses.title: 1.38 yady apy ete na
verses.sanskrit:
यद्यप्येते न पश्यन्ति लोभोपहतचेतसः ।
कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं मित्रद्रोहे च पातकम् ॥ १-३८॥
verses.roman:
yadyapyete na paśyanti lobhopahatacetasaḥ
kulakṣayakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ mitradrohe ca pātakam 1-38
verses.colloquial:
yadyapyete na pashyanti lobha upahata chetasah
kula kshaya kritam dosham mitra drohe cha paatakam 1-38
verses.translation_reworded: Even if these men, their judgment clouded by greed, see nothing wrong in destroying families in society and no sin in betraying friends,

verses.title: 1.39 katham na jneyam
verses.sanskrit:
कथं न ज्ञेयमस्माभिः पापादस्मान्निवर्तितुम् ।
कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं प्रपश्यद्भिर्जनार्दन ॥ १-३९॥
verses.roman:
kathaṃ na jñeyamasmābhiḥ pāpādasmānnivartitum
kulakṣayakṛtaṃ doṣaṃ prapaśyadbhirjanārdana 1-39
verses.colloquial:
katham na jneyam asmaabhih paapaad asmaan nivartitum
kula kshaya kritam dosham prapashyadbhih janaardana 1-39
verses.translation_reworded: why should we, who plainly see the evil in destroying family units, not learn to turn away from this sin, Janardana?

verses.title: 1.40 kula-kshaye pranashyanti
verses.sanskrit:
कुलक्षये प्रणश्यन्ति कुलधर्माः सनातनाः ।
धर्मे नष्टे कुलं कृत्स्नमधर्मोऽभिभवत्युत ॥ १-४०॥
verses.roman:
kulakṣaye praṇaśyanti kuladharmāḥ sanātanāḥ
dharme naṣṭe kulaṃ kṛtsnamadharmo'bhibhavatyuta 1-40
verses.colloquial:
kula kshaye pranashyanti kula dharmaah sanaatanaah
dharme nashte kulam kritsnam adharmah abhibhavati uta 1-40
verses.translation_reworded: When a family is destroyed, its age-old religious traditions die with it; and once spirituality is lost, impiety takes hold of the entire family.

verses.title: 1.41 adharmabhibhavat
verses.sanskrit:
अधर्माभिभवात्कृष्ण प्रदुष्यन्ति कुलस्त्रियः ।
स्त्रीषु दुष्टासु वार्ष्णेय जायते वर्णसङ्करः ॥ १-४१॥
verses.roman:
adharmābhibhavātkṛṣṇa praduṣyanti kulastriyaḥ
strīṣu duṣṭāsu vārṣṇeya jāyate varṇasaṅkaraḥ 1-41
verses.colloquial:
adharma abhibhavaat krishna pradushyanti kula striyah
striishu dushtaasu vaarshneya jaayate varna sankarah 1-41
verses.translation_reworded: When impiety spreads, Krishna, the women of the family become corrupted; and when the women are corrupted, descendant of the Vrishnis, the castes become mixed (varna-samkara).

verses.title: 1.42 sankaro narakayaiva
verses.sanskrit:
सङ्करो नरकायैव कुलघ्नानां कुलस्य च ।
पतन्ति पितरो ह्येषां लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रियाः ॥ १-४२॥
verses.roman:
saṅkaro narakāyaiva kulaghnānāṃ kulasya ca
patanti pitaro hyeṣāṃ luptapiṇḍodakakriyāḥ 1-42
verses.colloquial:
sankaro narakaayaiva kulaghnaanaam kulasya cha
patanti pitaro hyeshaam lupta pinda udaka kriyaah 1-42
verses.translation_reworded: This mixing of castes sends the destroyers of the family to hell, and their ancestors fall too, deprived of their offerings of pinda (rice-balls) and water libations.

verses.title: 1.43 doshair etaih kula-ghnanam
verses.sanskrit:
दोषैरेतैः कुलघ्नानां वर्णसङ्करकारकैः ।
उत्साद्यन्ते जातिधर्माः कुलधर्माश्च शाश्वताः ॥ १-४३॥
verses.roman:
doṣairetaiḥ kulaghnānāṃ varṇasaṅkarakārakaiḥ
utsādyante jātidharmāḥ kuladharmāśca śāśvatāḥ 1-43
verses.colloquial:
doshair etaih kulaghnaanaam varna sankara kaarakaih
utsaadyante jaati dharmaah kula dharmaah cha shaashvataah 1-43
verses.translation_reworded: Through these wrongful acts of the family's destroyers, which bring about the mixing of castes, the everlasting religious traditions of caste and family are wiped out.

verses.title: 1.44 utsanna-kula-dharmanam
verses.sanskrit:
उत्सन्नकुलधर्माणां मनुष्याणां जनार्दन ।
नरके नियतं वासो भवतीत्यनुशुश्रुम ॥ १-४४॥
verses.roman:
utsannakuladharmāṇāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ janārdana
narake niyataṃ vāso bhavatītyanuśuśruma 1-44
verses.colloquial:
utsanna kula dharmaanaam manushyaanaam janaardana
narake niyatam vaaso bhavatiiti anushushruma 1-44
verses.translation_reworded: We have heard, Janardana, that people whose family religious practices have been destroyed must inevitably live in hell for an unknown length of time.

verses.title: 1.45 aho bata mahat papam
verses.sanskrit:
अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम् ।
यद्राज्यसुखलोभेन हन्तुं स्वजनमुद्यताः ॥ १-४५॥
verses.roman:
aho bata mahatpāpaṃ kartuṃ vyavasitā vayam
yadrājyasukhalobhena hantuṃ svajanamudyatāḥ 1-45
verses.colloquial:
aho bata mahat paapam kartum vyavasitaa vayam
yad raajya sukha lobhena hantum svajana mudyataah 1-45
verses.translation_reworded: What a tragedy! We have set ourselves on a terrible sin: out of greed for the pleasures of a kingdom, we are ready to kill our own relatives.

verses.title: 1.46 yadi mam apratikaram
verses.sanskrit:
यदि मामप्रतीकारमशस्त्रं शस्त्रपाणयः ।
धार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस्तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत् ॥ १-४६॥
verses.roman:
yadi māmapratīkāramaśastraṃ śastrapāṇayaḥ
dhārtarāṣṭrā raṇe hanyustanme kṣemataraṃ bhavet 1-46
verses.colloquial:
yadi maam apratiikaaram ashastram shastra paanayah
dhaarta raashtraa rane hanyus tanme kshemataram bhavet 1-46
verses.translation_reworded: It would be better for me if the sons of Dhritarashtra, weapons in hand, killed me in battle while I stood unarmed and offered no resistance.

verses.title: 1.47 evam uktvarjunah
verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच ।
एवमुक्त्वार्जुनः सङ्ख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् ।
विसृज्य सशरं चापं शोकसंविग्नमानसः ॥ १-४७॥ 

ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे
अर्जुनविषादयोगो नाम प्रथमोऽध्यायः ॥ १॥
verses.roman:
sañjaya uvāca
evamuktvārjunaḥ saṅkhye rathopastha upāviśat
visṛjya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ śokasaṃvignamānasaḥ 1-47

oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu
brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde
arjunaviṣādayogo nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ 1
verses.colloquial:
sanjaya uvaacha
evam uktvaa arjunah sankhye rathopastha upaavishat
visrijya sasharam chaapam shoka samvigna maanasah

om tat sat iti shriimad bhagavad giitaasu upanishatsu
brahma vidyaayaam yoga shaastre shrii krishna arjuna samvaade
arjuna vishaada yogo naama prathamo'dhyaayah 1
verses.translation_reworded:
Sanjaya said: Having spoken this way on the battlefield, Arjuna threw down his bow and arrows and sank onto the seat of the chariot, his mind overwhelmed by grief.

So ends the first discourse, called "The Yoga of Arjuna's Despondency," in the Upanishads of the glorious Bhagavad Gita, the science of the Eternal, the scripture of Yoga, the dialogue between Sri Krishna and Arjuna.
